blockers: A levy requires actual adopted terms, a saved company taxable base and cash in its own account.
An owner exposure requires an active recorded business-owner relationship; no ownership share or personal distribution is inferred.
Completed receipts less completed payroll remain an incomplete operating-income estimate; nonpay costs, tax deductions and legal form are not inferred.
The same authority reader supplies the recorded rule or marked modal estimate for every place; a legal prohibition still refuses the levy.
Only wage-income categories authorize this instrument; employer payroll and head taxes do not authorize a personal income tax.
The adopted rate and recorded taxable occurrence are required; missing wages create no base or payment.
